Job Summary The Product Implementation Manager (PIM) within the Capability Hub acts as the operational backbone of the Global Product Management organization, serving as a central hub for portfolio governance, compliance, implementation, and strategic portfolio support. The role supports the execution of Global Product Management priorities across lubricant portfolios, including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, and Greases, depending on business requirements and job grade. The position focuses on data-driven portfolio management, knowledge management, compliance coordination, analytics, and digital enablement to ensure consistency, scalability, and governance across regions while driving execution against defined KPIs and SLAs. By coordinating cross-functional, cross-regional, and system-related activities, Product Implementation Managers enable Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs to focus on portfolio strategy, innovation, customer engagement, and long-term business growth. In addition, PIMs provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to regional FPIMs and RAPMs, ensuring effective integration between global strategy and regional execution. At more senior levels, the role also provides guidance and support to the wider PIM community, drives capability development, and contributes to portfolio optimization, digital transformation, and strategic planning initiatives across the Global Product Management organization. What you ll be doing Portfolio Management Product Lifecycle Support Manage the deployment, maintenance, and governance of regional and global product portfolios across business systems, including full GPC data ownership. Support and maintain Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) processes, ensuring portfolio data accuracy, integrity, and governance compliance. Provide implementation support for product launches, portfolio changes, and withdrawal of obsolete products. Support a range of lubricant portfolios including PCMO, HDDEO, Brake Oils, Transmissions, Marine, Coolants, Industrial Lubricants, Greases, and other assigned portfolios based on business priorities. Data Governance, Analytics Portfolio Optimization Ensure accurate and consistent portfolio data management across multiple systems and regions. Develop, maintain, and analyse KPI and SLA dashboards to support portfolio performance monitoring and decision-making. Drive analytics and insights to support formulation cost optimization, portfolio rationalization, and business performance improvement. Provide structured analysis and recommendations to support regional and global portfolio planning activities. Strategic Portfolio Support Support Global Product Managers (GPMs) and Associate GPMs in developing and executing 5+ year portfolio strategies and roadmap plans. Provide implementation, risk, feasibility, and execution perspectives to support strategic portfolio decisions. Contribute to portfolio optimization initiatives through data-driven insights and business recommendations. Compliance, Quality Governance Coordinate and maintain compliance documentation, including SDS, product registrations, certifications, approvals, waivers, and governance records. Manage and maintain digital PPAP records and quality-related portfolio documentation. Ensure adherence to internal governance, quality assurance, and regulatory requirements. Maintain central repositories for formulations, approvals, compliance records, and portfolio documentation. PPAP, Licensing Project Support Support and/or coordinate PPAP activities for automotive-related products, including readiness assessments, documentation, quality assurance requirements, and implementation activities. Own or support product licensing activities, including documentation management, approvals, renewals, and implementation support. Provide support for Joint Venture (JV), portfolio implementation, and special project activities where applicable. Coordinate with manufacturing sites, quality teams, FPIMs, RAPMs, and other stakeholders to ensure successful implementation and compliance. Digital Enablement Continuous Improvement Act as a key user, trainer, and subject matter resource for portfolio management and digital tools. Collaborate with digital and system development teams to identify and implement tool enhancements. Drive continuous improvement initiatives across portfolio management processes, systems, governance practices, and workflows. Support capability-building and digital adoption initiatives across regional and global teams. Stakeholder Collaboration Execution Support Provide system-level portfolio management and implementation support to FPIMs, RAPMs, and regional stakeholders. Coordinate cross-functional activities involving Product Management, Technology, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Commercial, and Procurement teams. Support additive transitions, supplier escalations, and portfolio-related implementation activities in collaboration with GAAMs and other stakeholders. Organize governance forums, stakeholder reviews, training sessions, and knowledge-sharing activities to drive alignment and best-practice adoption. Leadership Capability Building (Senior PIM Levels) Act as a senior PIM for complex or high-value portfolios, providing guidance, coaching, and support to less experienced PIMs. Lead strategic initiatives focused on portfolio transformation, governance excellence, and digital enablement. Support long-term capability development across the PIM community. Influence portfolio management, governance, and implementation decisions through thought leadership, analytics, and subject matter expertise. Champion best practices and drive consistency across regions, functions, and portfolio teams. What you bring A background in physical or chemical product testing, product development, or a formal qualification in technical sciences, engineering, chemistry, mathematics, or a related discipline would be an advantage. Strong understanding of lubricant product specifications, formulations, manufacturing processes, and product quality requirements. Familiarity with blending operations, supply chain processes, and product lifecycle management concepts.

 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 PRODUCT MANAGER KEMIN CBR

ROLE SUMMARY
 Responsible for developing and executing product and marketing strategies for the Kemin CBR ruminant and veterinary retail portfolio, with accountability for portfolio growth, market development, brand positioning, gross margin, and marketing effectiveness.
 Manage the marketing mix across product, price, place, and promotion, translating scientific evidence, market intelligence, and customer insights into differentiated and commercially relevant product propositions.

 ¢ Collaborate closely with Sales, Technical Services, R&D, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, and Supply Chain to deliver portfolio priorities and achieve approved sales and profitability objectives.

1. Product Strategy and Portfolio Management
 ¢ Develop and execute annual product and marketing plans for the assigned ruminant and veterinary retail portfolio.

 ¢ Establish and monitor portfolio sales, gross-margin, market-development, and marketing-expenditure objectives.
 ¢ Identify portfolio gaps and new-product opportunities through market research, competitor analysis, customer feedback, and field insights.
 ¢ Manage product lifecycle activities, including new-product introductions, brand repositioning, portfolio improvements, performance reviews, and rationalization recommendations.

 ¢ Conduct market research to understand farmer needs, purchasing behaviour, retailer feedback, competitor offerings, and opportunities in ruminant health and nutrition.
 ¢ Assess market trends, competitive pricing, product differentiation, and gaps in retail availability.
 ¢ Support Sales in developing territory-specific marketing plans and identifying opportunities for geographic and channel expansion.

 ¢ Gather, analyze, and consolidate customer and channel insights to guide product development, communication, and promotional priorities.

3. New-Product Development and Launch Execution

4. Scientific Communication and Brand Promotion
 ¢ Develop scientific articles, technical bulletins, product presentations, sales manuals, training modules, flyers, and customer-education materials.

 ¢ Ensure product communications and claims are scientifically substantiated and reviewed through the appropriate internal approval process.
 ¢ Plan and execute marketing campaigns, product-awareness programs, and brand-building initiatives aligned with portfolio objectives.
 ¢ Develop point-of-sale materials, retailer branding, and farmer-facing communication tools.

 ¢ Develop structured training modules and conduct post-training assessments to evaluate learning effectiveness, in coordination with sales training faculties.
 ¢ Provide scientific and technical support for customer presentations, field meetings, product demonstrations, and sales campaigns.
 ¢ Coordinate with Technical Services and R&D to address complex product queries and customer feedback.
 ¢ Strengthen sales effectiveness by providing timely promotional inputs and practical field-communication tools.
 ¢ Ensure consistent product messaging across sales teams, channel partners, and customer-facing materials.
6. Farmer Education and Veterinary Engagement
 ¢ Coordinate farmer-education programs on livestock nutrition, preventive animal healthcare, and productivity topics relevant to the portfolio.
 ¢ Work with veterinary and technical teams to develop practical educational content and field-engagement activities.
 ¢ Support farmer meetings, veterinary interactions, and product demonstrations in coordination with Sales and Technical Services.
 ¢ Collect and analyze field data and customer feedback to evaluate engagement activities and identify improvement opportunities.
 ¢ Apply veterinary knowledge to understand customer needs and support responsible product education and communication.
7. Commercial Performance and Cost Optimization
 ¢ Track product-level sales, gross margin, marketing expenditure, and campaign performance against approved plans.
 ¢ Prepare periodic portfolio-performance reports and recommend actions to improve growth, profitability, and execution effectiveness.
 ¢ Optimize expenditure on sampling, promotional materials, vendor services, and marketing activities without compromising execution quality.
 ¢ Work with Purchasing to evaluate competitive sourcing opportunities that support approved product and cost objectives.
 ¢ Collaborate with Manufacturing and Finance to evaluate standard costs and support agreed cost-improvement targets.
 ¢ Assess the commercial effectiveness of launches, campaigns, and field activities to improve resource allocation and return on marketing investment.
8. Cross-functional Coordination and Process Improvement
 ¢ Coordinate with Sales, R&D, Technical Services, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Finance, Quality, and Supply Chain to execute portfolio priorities.
 ¢ Establish effective processes for customer feedback, technical-query escalation, and response tracking.
 ¢ Improve workflows for product launches, training delivery, promotional-material development, and marketing execution.
 ¢ Maintain accurate product documentation, training records, market intelligence, project updates, and approved marketing materials.
 ¢ Support team coordination, knowledge sharing, and timely delivery of agreed initiatives.
 ¢ Escalate material portfolio risks, project delays, budget deviations, and investment requirements to the General Manager in a timely manner.
QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE
 ¢ Must have: Bachelors degree in Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandry, Animal Nutrition, or a related scientific discipline.
¢ Preferred: A postgraduate qualification in Veterinary Pharmacology and Toxicology, Animal Nutrition, or a related veterinary discipline is preferred. A management qualification is an added advantage.
 ¢ Approximately 57 years of relevant experience across animal health, veterinary practice, research, technical services, sales, or marketing.
 ¢ At least 3 years of experience in product management, animal-health marketing, veterinary affairs, or a closely related commercial role.
 ¢ Demonstrated experience in product launches, market research, scientific communication, sales training, and cross-functional coordination.
 ¢ Experience in ruminant health, livestock nutrition, farmer engagement, or retail-channel marketing is preferred.
 ¢ Candidates with companion-animal product-management experience may be considered where they demonstrate relevant livestock exposure and transferable commercial and technical capabilities.
CORE COMPETENCIES
 Commercial and Product Management Product strategy and lifecycle management; market research and competitor analysis; opportunity identification; brand positioning; launch planning; sales and gross-margin analysis; marketing-budget management; cost optimization; retail-channel and customer engagement. Scientific and Technical Veterinary scientific knowledge and evidence interpretation; scientific and technical writing; product training and knowledge transfer; technical sales support; customer-query coordination; translation of research findings into product communication; field-data analysis and reporting. Behavioral and Execution Cross-functional collaboration; team coordination; influencing; presentation and interpersonal communication; vendor negotiation and relationship management; planning and project management; customer orientation; problem-solving; accountability; decisiveness; continuous improvement.
TRAVEL REQUIREMENT
